registry_api_audit.scope: Python audit event names and counts, not a complete operating-system access trace

interpretation: The real native collector generated a structurally valid partial inventory; exit code zero does not mean complete coverage.
Retained records are registrations, not a count of installed applications; views and records may overlap.
Both local-machine scopes had unreadable enumerated child keys. Both current-user scopes could not be read.
The collector retained generic read-failure categories, not the underlying Windows error codes, so not every failure can be attributed specifically to permissions.
The audit recorded read-related API event types only; event names alone do not prove every underlying target or parameter.
No real application-directory association, file ownership, orphan status or cleanup decision was validated by this collection run.
No registered application files were opened, moved or cleaned, and no registry write or uninstall command was performed by the collector.
No software was downloaded or installed for this validation.
